title: Training Advisors for LLM Agents from Task Outcomes
title_zh: 从任务结果出发训练 LLM 智能体的顾问模型

paragraphs.en: Large language model agents tackle multi-step tasks by interleaving reasoning and tool calls with observations from the environment. Prior work has shown that natural-language feedback can help these agents revise their decisions during task execution. We introduce Caddie , a method for training critics to provide natural-language analysis and advice as agents work through a task. Unlike approaches that rely on step-level labels or reference critiques, Caddie learns from whether the agent ultimately succeeds after receiving the critic’s feedback. We optimize the critic through reinforcement learning while keeping the base model frozen. Trained on multi-hop question answering with a single base model, our Qwen3-4B critic improves success rates across four base models of different scales and architectures, including three not used during critic training. On the MuSiQue benchmark, the trained critic improves Qwen3-4B’s success rate by more than 25 percentage points, surpassing the performance of Kimi K3 without a critic. The same critic also yields gains on out-of-domain interactive benchmarks, including τ 3 \tau^{3} and DeepDive, with no additional training. Our results show that agents can decide when to seek help from a critic at inference time and that outcome-based critic training can produce guidance that transfers across base models and task domains.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型智能体通过交替进行推理、工具调用和环境观察，来完成多步骤任务。 先前的研究已经表明，自然语言反馈可以帮助这些智能体在任务执行过程中修正其决策。 我们提出了 Caddie，一种训练批评者的方法，使其能够在智能体执行任务时提供自然语言分析和建议。 与依赖步骤级标签或参考性批评的方法不同，Caddie 通过观察智能体在接收批评者反馈后最终是否成功来进行学习。 我们在保持基础模型冻结的同时，通过强化学习对批评者进行优化。 我们的 Qwen3-4B 批评者在单基础模型上进行多跳问答训练后，能够提升四种不同规模和架构的基础模型的成功率，其中三种模型在批评者训练过程中并未使用。 在 MuSiQue 基准测试中，训练后的批评者将 Qwen3-4B 的成功率提升了超过 25 个百分点，超过了 Kimi K3 在没有批评者时的表现。 同一批评者在无需额外训练的情况下，也能在 τ 3 \tau^{3} 和 DeepDive 等跨领域互动基准测试中带来性能提升。 我们的结果表明，智能体可以在推理阶段自行决定何时向批评者寻求帮助，并且基于结果的批评者训练方法能够生成适用于不同基础模型和任务领域的指导信息。

paragraphs.en: Large language model (LLM)-based agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yao et al., 2025 ) increasingly tackle multi-step tasks by producing actions and reacting to environment observations. During its execution, an agent can get stuck repeating unsuccessful actions or lose sight of the original goal ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2025 ) . External feedback offers a way to help models reconsider their approach and steer the agent toward a successful solution by identifying problems and suggesting more useful next actions.
paragraphs.zh: 基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体（Yao 等人，2023；Yao 等人，2025）越来越多地通过执行动作和响应环境观察来处理多步骤任务。 在执行过程中，智能体可能会陷入重复无效动作的困境，或偏离最初的目标（Shinn 等人，2023；Kim 等人，2025）。 外部反馈提供了一种帮助模型重新评估其方法的方式，并通过识别问题、提出更有用的后续动作，引导智能体走向成功的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: Costly supervision. Many PRMs require step-level training labels. Human annotation ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) can provide these labels, but collecting them at scale is expensive ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . paragraphs.en: Ambiguous step correctness. Correctness-based assessment assumes that intermediate actions can be meaningfully classified as correct or faulty. In interactive environments, an apparently unproductive action may be needed to explore the environment or gather information. Recent agent PRMs ( Xi et al., 2025 ) address this ambiguity by estimating future success, but using these scores to choose a better action still requires an additional selection or search procedure.
paragraphs.zh: 步骤正确性的模糊性。 基于正确性的评估假设中间动作可以被有意义地划分为正确或错误。 在交互式环境中，一个看似无益的动作可能对于探索环境或收集信息是必要的。 近期的智能体 PRM（Xi 等人，2025）通过预测未来成功概率来解决这种模糊性，但利用这些分数来选择更优动作仍然需要额外的选择或搜索过程。

paragraphs.en: Critique-based methods ( Akyurek et al., 2023 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Xi et al., 2026 ) provide a complementary interface: natural-language feedback can explain a problem in the agent’s current context and suggest how to proceed. By guiding the next action directly, such feedback can reduce the need for search, branching, or replay, which may be costly in some interactive environments. Such a method also makes potential errors and proposed next steps easier to interpret.
paragraphs.zh: 基于批判的方法（Akyurek 等人，2023；Xie 等人，2025；Xi 等人，2026）提供了一种互补的接口：自然语言反馈可以在智能体的当前上下文中解释问题，并提出后续步骤的建议。 通过直接指导下一步行动，此类反馈可以减少搜索、分支或重播的需求，而这些操作在某些交互环境中可能代价高昂。 这种方法也使得潜在错误和提议的下一步骤更容易被理解。

paragraphs.en: However, it is not straightforward how to train such critics effectively. Existing approaches train such critics through procedures that include synthesizing reference critiques (CTRL; Xie et al., 2025 ) or separately optimizing their ability to judge and improve solutions (Critique-RL; Xi et al., 2026 ). These methods demonstrate the value of learned feedback and motivate simpler ways to train it for an agent that must continue acting and observing.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，如何有效训练这类批评者并非易事。 现有方法通过一系列流程来训练这类批评者，包括合成参考性批评（CTRL；Xie 等人，2025）或分别优化其判断和改进步骤的能力（Critique-RL；Xi 等人，2026）。 这些方法证明了学习反馈的价值，并启发我们寻找更简单的训练方式，以适用于必须持续行动和观察的智能体。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Caddie , a method for training critics to guide agents during task execution (Figure 1 ). During training, we sample intermediate points in an agent’s trajectory and ask the critic to provide natural-language analysis and advice. The agent then continues with this feedback, and we use its final task outcome as the reward for updating the critic through reinforcement learning, while keeping the agent frozen. We directly optimize the final outcome of the policy being steered, and require neither step-level annotations nor reference critiques. At inference time, the agent can decide when to consult the trained critic.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Caddie，一种训练评论员在任务执行过程中指导智能体的方法（图 1）。 在训练期间，我们从智能体的轨迹中采样中间点，并要求评论员提供自然语言分析和建议。 随后，智能体根据这些反馈继续执行任务，我们将任务的最终结果用作奖励，通过强化学习更新评论员，同时保持智能体冻结不变。 我们直接优化所引导策略的最终结果，既不需要步骤级的标注，也不需要参考性评论。 在推理阶段，智能体可以自行决定何时咨询训练好的评论员。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach across multiple benchmarks and base models to study both in-domain effectiveness and generalizability to other base models and tasks. We also examine how the usefulness of feedback depends on the base model and the critic inference setup.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在多个基准测试和基础模型上评估了我们的方法，以研究其在特定领域内的有效性以及对其他基础模型和任务的泛化能力。 我们还研究了反馈的有用性如何依赖于基础模型和评论者推理设置。

sents.zh: 这种表述也限制了任务和环境的选取。

sents.en: For tasks solvable in a single step with a small token budget and no tool calls, an optimal critic may learn to solve the task itself and instruct the base model to copy its solution.

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether outcome-based critic training improves task performance and whether the learned feedback transfers to base models and tasks unseen during critic training.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估基于结果的评论者训练是否能提升任务表现，以及所学到的反馈能否迁移到评论者训练期间未接触过的基模型和任务中。

paragraphs.en: We study in-domain performance on MuSiQue ( Trivedi et al., 2022 ) and ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2021 ) , training a separate critic for each setting. MuSiQue requires combining evidence across two to four reasoning hops. We use two retrieval settings: attached , in which the agent retrieves evidence from the 20 supplied passages, and wiki , in which it searches Wikipedia. ALFWorld requires agents to navigate text-based household environments and interact with objects to complete tasks. To test transfer beyond the training tasks, we evaluate the MuSiQue-trained critics on DeepDive ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , which requires web search to answer questions synthesized from knowledge graphs, and on τ 3 \tau^{3} Retail and Airline ( Yao et al., 2025 ; Sierra Research, 2026 ) , which require customer dialogue and tool use under domain-specific policies.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MuSiQue（Trivedi 等人，2022）和 ALFWorld（Shridhar 等人，2021）上研究领域内性能，并为每种设置训练一个独立的批评者。 MuSiQue 需要结合两到四个推理步骤中的证据。 我们使用两种检索设置：附加模式，其中智能体从提供的 20 个段落中检索证据；以及维基百科模式，其中智能体在维基百科上搜索。 ALFWorld 要求智能体在基于文本的家庭环境中导航，并与物体互动以完成任务。 为了测试模型在训练任务之外的迁移能力，我们在 DeepDive（Lu 等人，2025）上评估了使用 MuSiQue 训练的批评者，该任务需要通过网络搜索来回答从知识图谱中合成的问题；同时也在 τ₃ Retail 和 Airline（Yao 等人，2025；Sierra Research，2026）上进行了评估，这些任务要求在特定领域的策略下处理客户对话并使用工具。

paragraphs.en: We compare Caddie with no critic, a prompted Qwen3-4B critic, and a prompted Kimi K3 critic. paragraphs.en: For each condition, we generate eight independent rollouts per task using distinct seeds and fixed model checkpoints. For the smaller DeepDive and τ 3 \tau^{3} evaluation sets (Table 3 ), we instead compute the SEM across the eight seed-level aggregate accuracies, where each seed’s success rate over all tasks is one sample.

paragraphs.en: Caddie achieves the highest mean success rate in both MuSiQue settings and on ALFWorld (Table 1 ). Relative to the no-critic baseline, it improves success on MuSiQue by 25.31 percentage points with attached passages, 10.75 points with Wikipedia retrieval and by 25.93 points on ALFWorld. The trained 4B critic also outperforms both prompted critics in all three settings, indicating that outcome-based training produces more useful feedback than prompting alone in these evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: Caddie 在 MuSiQue 的两种设置以及 ALFWorld 中都实现了最高的平均成功率（表 1）。 与无批评者基线相比，附加语段后，它在 MuSiQue 上的成功率提升了 25.31 个百分点；使用维基百科检索后提升了 10.75 个百分点；在 ALFWorld 上则提升了 25.93 个百分点。 训练后的 4B 批评者在所有三种设置中也都优于两种提示批评者，这表明在这些评估中，基于结果的训练比仅靠提示能生成更有用的反馈。

paragraphs.en: To study whether a critic can further improve a generator that has already been trained on the downstream task, we first trained the Qwen3-4B generator with DAPO-based optimization until it plateaus, then froze it and trained a critic through its continuations. On MuSiQue-attached, this additionally raises success from 49.69 % 49.69\% to 63.56 % 63.56\% ( + 13.88 +13.88 percentage points), showing that critic feedback can provide further gains even after the generator itself has been trained on the task. This suggests that the two forms of training are complementary. Appendix E gives the training setup and results for both retrieval settings.

paragraphs.en: Caddie improves over the no-critic baseline and achieves a higher mean than both prompted critics in all six conditions (Table 2 ). With attached passages, gains over the no-critic baseline range from 9.31 to 13.19 percentage points across the three models. Transfer is less consistent with Wikipedia retrieval, ranging from 0.81 to 6.19 points; Qwen3.8-27B increases from 26.69% to 27.50%. Thus, a critic trained with a 4B base model can benefit larger base models without adaptation, although the magnitude of the benefit depends on the base model and retrieval setting.
paragraphs.zh: Caddie 在性能上优于无批评者基线模型，并且在所有六种条件下都实现了比两种提示批评者更高的平均值（表 2）。 在附加了段落的情况下，三种模型相较于无批评者基线模型的性能提升幅度在 9.31 到 13.19 个百分点之间。 使用维基百科检索时的性能迁移效果则不太稳定，提升幅度在 0.81 到 6.19 分之间；Qwen3.8-27B 的性能从 26.69% 提升至 27.50%。 因此，使用 4B 基础模型训练的批评者无需适配即可为更大的基础模型带来益处，尽管这种益处的具体程度取决于基础模型和检索设置。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate both MuSiQue-trained critics on 40 τ 3 \tau^{3} Retail tasks, 20 τ 3 \tau^{3} Airline tasks, and a subset of 64 DeepDive tasks without further critic training. In each critic-assisted condition, the frozen base model uses the self-call protocol to request feedback. For τ 3 \tau^{3} , we use the updated benchmark environments with the predefined test splits inherited from τ 2 \tau^{2} -bench. Evaluation with Qwen3-4B tests task transfer; evaluation with Qwen3.8-27B tests joint transfer across tasks and base models. For all out-of-domain evaluations, both the critic and the base model use a maximum context length of 32,768 tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 40 个 τ 3 \tau^{3} 零售任务、20 个 τ 3 \tau^{3} 航空任务以及一个包含 64 个 DeepDive 任务的子集上，对使用 MuSiQue 训练的两种批评者进行评估，且无需进一步训练批评者。 在每个由批评者辅助的条件下，冻结的基础模型都会使用自调用协议来请求反馈。 对于 τ 3 \tau^{3}，我们使用经过更新的标准测试环境，其中预定义的测试划分继承自 τ 2 \tau^{2}-bench。 使用 Qwen3-4B 进行的评估可检验任务迁移能力；使用 Qwen3.8-27B 进行的评估则可检验跨任务和基础模型的联合迁移能力。 在所有域外评估中，批评者和基础模型均使用最大上下文长度 32,768 个词元。

paragraphs.en: Together, these results suggest a simple OOD mechanism: the generator calls Caddie selectively, and the critic adapts its correction to both the target domain and the generator’s characteristic weakness.
paragraphs.zh: 这些结果共同表明了一种简单的 OOD 机制：生成器会选择性地调用 Caddie，而评判者则会针对目标域和生成器的典型弱点调整其修正方式。

paragraphs.en: Our method is intended for multi-step, tool-using tasks whose solutions require further environment interactions. On self-contained tasks, such as step-by-step mathematical reasoning, the critic can instead learn to generate complete solutions for the base model to copy, which can be optimal under the outcome-based objective. In this case, the critic learns to act as a task-solving policy, limiting its ability to transfer across base models and tasks. We discuss this further in Appendix K .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法适用于多步骤、需要使用工具的任务，这些任务的解决方案需要与环境进行进一步的交互。 对于自包含的任务（例如分步数学推理），批评者可以转而学习为基础模型生成完整的解决方案以供其复制，这在基于结果的优化目标下可能是最优的。 在这种情况下，批评者会学习充当任务解决策略，从而限制其在不同基础模型和任务之间的迁移能力。 我们在附录 K 中对此进行了更深入的讨论。

paragraphs.en: Our formulation treats critique as an intervention rather than a correctness judgment about an individual step. Scalar verifiers can rank or select candidate continuations, whereas a generative critic supplies text that conditions the base model’s next actions. These approaches can be combined. Our experiments do not establish that natural-language feedback is generally superior to scalar verification; such a comparison would require matched inference procedures and compute budgets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法将批判视为一种干预，而非对单个步骤正确性的判断。 标量验证器可以排序或选择候选续写内容，而生成式批判者则提供文本以约束基础模型的下一次操作。 这些方法可以结合使用。 我们的实验并未证明自然语言反馈通常优于标量验证；要进行此类比较，需要匹配的推理流程和计算资源。

paragraphs.en: RL4F ( Akyurek et al., 2023 ) and CTRL ( Xie et al., 2025 ) train critics to improve a frozen model’s revised outputs. Both methods initialize the critic with supervised critique examples: RL4F uses human-written or programmatically generated feedback, while CTRL synthesizes critiques using code-execution feedback. Critique-RL ( Xi et al., 2026 ) first trains correctness judgments, then optimizes feedback for successful revisions while preserving judgment accuracy. We train the critic directly from the final outcomes of agent continuations, providing advice during an ongoing trajectory without supervised critique initialization or a separate correctness-judgment stage.

paragraphs.en: Steer, Don’t Solve ( Gandhi et al., 2026 ) trains critics using teacher feedback and judge-ranked preferences. Agent-RRM ( Fan et al., 2026 ) trains an evaluator whose critiques guide revisions of completed attempts. Closest to our work, Advisor Models ( Asawa et al., 2026 ) train a small advisor with GRPO to write per-instance advice for a frozen student, rewarded only by the student’s task reward, and show that an advisor trained with a low-cost student transfers to frontier models. We share this training signal but differ in where credit is assigned, when advice arrives, and what transfers. They score advice by the student’s response to the whole query, delivered before the response, after a completed attempt, or every five steps in their coding-agent experiments; we branch from a sampled intermediate state and compare G G critiques through continuations from that same state, so the critic learns to correct an episode in progress rather than to prompt a fresh attempt. Their advice follows a fixed schedule; our agent requests it through call_critic when uncertain, avoiding the schedule sensitivity shown in Appendix F . They report transfer across students and no degradation on other benchmarks; we show gains for unseen base models on unseen task families without any adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: Steer, Don’t Solve (Gandhi 等，2026) 利用教师反馈和评审员排序的偏好来训练批评者。 Agent-RRM（Fan 等，2026）训练一个评估器，其批评指导已完成尝试的修改。 与我们的工作最接近的是 Advisor Models（Asawa 等，2026），该模型使用 GRPO 训练一个小型顾问，为冻结的学生模型生成每个实例的建议，仅通过学生的任务奖励获得激励，并证明了以低成本学生模型训练的顾问可以迁移到前沿模型。 我们共享这一训练信号，但在信用分配的位置、建议到达的时间以及可迁移的内容上有所不同。 他们根据学生对整个查询的响应来评分建议；在编码智能体实验中，建议在响应前、完成尝试后或每五个步骤中提供一次。而我们则从采样得到的中间状态分支，并通过从同一状态开始的后续操作比较 G G 批评，因此批评者学会纠正正在进行的流程，而非提示重新开始。 他们的建议遵循固定时间表；而我们的智能体在不确定时通过 call_critic 请求建议，从而避免了附录 F 中展示的时间表敏感性。 他们报告了跨学生模型的迁移效果，且在其他基准测试上未出现性能下降；而我们则证明，无需任何适配，模型就能在未见的任务族中对未见的基线模型取得提升。

paragraphs.en: We introduced Caddie , a method for training natural-language critics to provide analysis and advice during an agent’s interaction. We adapt the GRPO-based optimization generally used for policy training to learn critiques from the final outcomes of a frozen base model’s continuations. Using task outcomes as a common training signal avoids the need for task-specific step labels or reference critiques.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Caddie，一种训练自然语言评论员的方法，使其能够在智能体交互过程中提供分析和建议。 我们将通常用于策略训练的基于 GRPO 的优化方法加以调整，以便从冻结基础模型续写结果的最终输出中学习评论。 使用任务结果作为通用的训练信号，可以避免使用特定于任务的步骤标签或参考评论。

paragraphs.en: On MuSiQue, our trained Qwen3-4B critic improves the Qwen3-4B base model’s success rate by 25.31 percentage points in the attached setting. The critic also transfers to base models not used during training, including Qwen3-30B-A3B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Kimi K3, and yields gains on out-of-domain tasks in τ 3 \tau^{3} and DeepDive without further training. These results show that the same training procedure can produce feedback that is useful across base models and task settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MuSiQue 中，我们训练好的 Qwen3-4B 评论器在附带的设置中将 Qwen3-4B 基础模型的成功率提升了 25.31 个百分点。 该评论器还能迁移到训练过程中未使用的基础模型，包括 Qwen3-30B-A3B、Qwen3.8-27B 和 Kimi K3，并且无需进一步训练即可在 τ 3 \tau^{3} 和 DeepDive 的非领域任务中取得提升。 这些结果表明，相同的训练流程可以生成在不同基础模型和任务设置下都有用的反馈。

paragraphs.en: We also identify a limitation concerning task structure. In self-contained tasks that can be solved in one pass, the critic can learn to generate complete solutions for the base model to copy, which can be optimal under the outcome-based objective.

paragraphs.en: Our main goal is to train critics that transfer across base models and tasks, including settings where the base policy cannot be optimized directly. We do not aim to show that critic training outperforms task-specific optimization of the base policy. In this experiment, direct GRPO training yielded slightly better results than pairing the original instruction-tuned generator with a critic. However, training a critic with the GRPO-trained generator provided further gains after the generator’s performance had plateaued, suggesting that the two approaches can be combined to improve task performance and achieve the better score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要目标是训练能够跨基础模型和任务迁移的批评者，包括那些无法直接优化基础策略的场景。 我们并不打算证明批评者训练的表现优于针对基础策略的任务特定优化。 在此实验中，直接的 GRPO 训练产生的结果略优于将原始指令调优生成器与批评者配对的方法。 然而，在生成器的性能趋于平稳后，使用经过 GRPO 训练的生成器来训练批评者仍能带来进一步的提升，这表明两种方法可以结合使用，以提高任务表现并获得更高的分数。

However, in self-contained tasks, such as mathematical reasoning, the critic may instead have enough information to produce a complete solution in a single step. paragraphs.en: The training signal can favor this behavior. Consider a group of G G critiques, each evaluated using N > 1 N>1 base-model continuations. General advice from the critic can steer the base model toward a particular solution, but the base model must still work out the remaining steps, so the continuations may have different outcomes and yield an intermediate average reward. If the base model reliably follows a complete solution given by the critic, the continuations tend to agree on the outcome. Correct solutions then receive rewards near one, and incorrect solutions receive rewards near zero, concentrating their rewards near the two endpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 训练信号可能会鼓励这种行为。 假设有一组 G 个批评，每个批评都使用 N > 1 个基础模型续写进行评估。 批评者提供的通用建议可以引导基础模型朝向某个特定解决方案，但基础模型仍需自行完成剩余步骤，因此这些续写可能会有不同的结果，并产生一个中间的平均奖励值。 如果基础模型能够可靠地遵循批评者给出的完整解决方案，那么这些续写往往会在结果上达成一致。 此时，正确解决方案获得的奖励会接近 1，而错误解决方案获得的奖励则接近 0，使得它们的奖励集中在两个端点附近。

paragraphs.en: Training requires continuing multiple branches from the same intermediate state. For retrieval over a fixed corpus, this can often be done by replaying the trajectory prefix. In stateful environments, the external environment must also be restored. For example, software-engineering tasks may require checkpointing files and running processes. Restoring equivalent states across branches can therefore be difficult or costly, particularly when tools interact with external services.
paragraphs.zh: 训练需要基于同一个中间状态继续多个分支。 对于在固定语料库中的检索，这通常可以通过重放轨迹前缀来实现。 在有状态的环境中，还必须恢复外部环境。 例如，软件工程任务可能需要对文件和运行进程进行存档。 因此，在不同分支之间恢复等效的状态可能具有困难或高成本，尤其是在工具与外部服务交互时。
